response.rationale: The proliferation originates from retinal vessels with pyramid-shaped growth and dendritic vascular structures, characteristic of RAP, whereas R1/R3 are broader neovascular AMD categories lacking this specific retinal-vessel origin.

rejected.why: Non-specific neovascular AMD; lacks the distinctive retinal-vessel proliferation pattern of RAP.
Overlaps with R1 but emphasizes exudative AMD; does not capture the unique OCTA pyramid-shaped retinal vascular proliferation.
